name: Watches your lane
text: You spent {pct}% of the wave in the {lane}. Next wave aims there.

name: Dodges sprays
text: {missed} of your {shots} shots missed. Next wave dodges more.

name: Guards its edges
text: {pct}% of your first hits were on the edge columns. The edges dodge now.

name: Fires on cover
text: You spent {pct}% of the wave under a barrier. The columns above them fire more.
